verdict.rationale: First-party support docs describe a dedicated ASC 718 Stock Option Expense Report workflow that outputs an Excel (.xlsx) file with ASC 718 calculations. The platform also organizes the grant types, vesting schedules and plan details those reports need, though the feature requires the Growth plan. Missing for 10: evidence the output is audit-ready or accepted by auditors (e.g. supporting schedules or methodology disclosure), coverage of non-option awards such as RSUs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
